CPM-100-25.note: Rated voltage 24-48 V. Allowable radial force 500 N, axial 300 N. Previously sold as SG-2556; the 2026 price list renames it CPM-100-25.

CPM-80-25.note: Rated voltage 24-48 V. Allowable radial force 500 N, axial 500 N.

SG-6010HB.note: Exoskeleton joint motor. Rated voltage 12-48 V.

_alias: SigGear renamed its cycloidal line for 2026: SG-2556 is now CPM-100-25 and SG-2368 is CPM-78-39. The old names are kept as aliases so a customer searching the number they were quoted still finds the part.
_prices: The SigGear quotations in 代理/sig motor 代理 are EXW factory prices to us — cost, not price. They belong in internal/costs.json and never on the page.
_scope: Joint actuators only. The SG-2877 and SG-2878 hub gear motors were removed: different product, and not among what SigGear says sells.
_source: 2026-03-19西格传动产品画册.pdf, pages 24-40. Transcribed by hand from the spec block on each product page after positional parsing proved unreliable on this layout — the labels, their English translations and the values are three separate text runs on a design grid, so reading order gives nonsense. Nine models carry a model number in the text layer; pages 41-56 do not, and are left out rather than guessed at.
